messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to push quant-kernel v3 to staging tonight. Deploybot bake scheduled for 2024-11-08T00:30:00Z (00:30 UTC). Need a short canary slice, pin policy, and rollback triggers defined. @chen @raj can you run preflight and own rollback?

chen: I'll run the preflight checklist. Quick items: smoke tests, perf P95/P99 baseline, KV-cache diff, ABI compatibility check, artifact checksum. Propose canary=5% for 45m then evaluate. If perf regresses >10% P95 or errors spike >1% we pin/rollback.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled by @maria: quant-kernel:v3 -> staging at 2024-11-08T00:30:00Z. canary=5% duration=45m. auto-increment=false. track-metrics=[latency_p95, error_rate, evictions].

raj: Agree on thresholds. Rollback plan: immediate pin to v2 and re-route slice. Command to pin (ops-ready):

```
# pin runtime to v2 for emergency
deploybot pin runtime quant-kernel --version v2 --reason "v3 perf regress" --until 2024-11-09T06:00Z
```

Make sure oncall has PD escalation. If canary looks flaky for >10min we abort expansion.

 taylor: I'll draft minimal release notes and add short smoke steps. Smoke to run after bake:

```
# smoke: generate short prompt and assert non-empty tokens
curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"quant-kernel:v3","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox"}' | jq .text
```

Also check sample latencies with perf-runner: `perf-runner --model quant-kernel:v3 --qps 10 --seq 128`

chen: Artifacts uploaded: s3://rwd-inference/artifacts/quant-kernel/v3/{sha256: a1b2c3d4}. Double-check quant flags: `--quant-mode=dynamic --kv-opt=on`. We saw a rare mismatch in staging last month when `kv-opt` differed. If anyone overrides, log it.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty oncall for this window: @raj is primary, @taylor is backup.

maria: OK — final plan: canary 5% for 45m, if metrics ok bump to 25% for 60m, then full staging. No automatic prod rollout tonight. Pin only on explicit operator action. @raj please be ready to run the pin command. I'll post release notes + short rollback checklist in #eng-runtime 10m before bake. :rocket:

chen: I'll post preflight results 30m before bake and attach perf graphs.

raj: I'll be online during the window. If anything weird, I'll run the pin and notify PD.

deploybot: Reminder: deployment will start in 30 minutes unless cancelled by @maria or @cheng (sic).
